answer: A bond is refunded only after 24 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The walnut counter is kept in sonnet and timber exposes each reset. An attacker therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 24 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 26 times over for the same share of the pool. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
